title: TSMC 2020 Annual Report, Letter to Shareholders

passages.note: Printed p. 11, N7, N7+ and N6. The base N7 volume production began in April 2018. TSMC reports volume use of EUV on N7+ since 2019, subsequent N6 adoption of EUV in place of conventional immersion layers, and the 2020 N5 production ramp.
